updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Admin Assignment Time Limit
updates.summary: Purview now allows administrators to set expiration dates (in days) when assigning users and security groups to role groups, enabling temporary admin access without manual removal. This is essential for enforcing least-privilege access and reducing standing administrative permissions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Role Management Enhancements
updates.summary: A new view-only role management capability has been added to Purview, allowing admins to see all member assignments across Purview and Defender without modification rights. This read-only permission is being integrated into the Global Reader and Security Reader roles in both Purview and Entra.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey Support for B2B Users
updates.summary: B2B users, including external guests, can now register and use passkeys to satisfy resource tenant MFA requirements, extending passwordless authentication beyond member users. This streamlines security for external collaboration scenarios by enabling passkey registration from the My Security Info page or during sign-in.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management for Departed Employees
updates.summary: Purview now enables automated deletion of both content and containers (OneDrives and mailboxes) for departed users at scale, eliminating manual cleanup efforts and ensuring regulatory compliance. This reduces security and compliance risk by preventing orphaned user data from remaining accessible.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network Data Security – General Availability
updates.summary: Purview now integrates Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access with DLP policies to protect sensitive data at the network layer, preventing exfiltration through browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. Admins can enforce restrictive actions on risky user activity detected through Insider Risk Management across untrusted cloud applications.
